description:
Fetch the result of a finished simulation job.
Inputs: jobId; full, optional, true for the whole payload instead of the summary (default false).
Example: {"jobId":"0b7c6f3e-5d1a-4c2e-9f8a-2a4e6b1d9c07"}
Returns: The headline values, warnings and provenance, with every series described rather than listed, the result page URL and a result link that lives 15 minutes. A job that has not finished returns its status and progress instead.

full.description: Return the whole payload instead of the summary. Large.

name: get_simulation_result
title: Get Simulation Result
